variances.meaning_english: a well-known term, from tying/knotting — as if parts of a thing are knotted to one another

entries.core_meaning: وهو الثَّوب الأخشن الرَّدىء النَّسَج، وهذه ملحوظةٌ من كلمتين: من غَمَّ وغَمَرَ

variances.meaning: يَمُجُّ ريقَه ولا يستطيع أن يَحبسه من كِبَرِه

he went off/departed into the land
the man hastened in his running

the elevation of the day as it lengthens

the amount of ink drawn from the inkwell with one's pen
